top_stories.title: Spanish Poll Indicates Concern Over Potential Conflict With Morocco
top_stories.summary: A recent survey shows that many Spaniards consider an armed conflict with Morocco possible following tensions surrounding Ceuta. The polling reflects heightened concern in Spain regarding stability and security near the North African territory.

top_stories.title: Russia Reports Substantial European Energy Purchases Since 2022
top_stories.summary: Russian officials stated that European countries have purchased 320 billion dollars in hydrocarbons since 2022. The statement points to ongoing energy commerce between Russia and Europe amid broad economic sanctions.

top_stories.title: Study Warns of Sharp Drop in Resilience Across Several EU Nations
top_stories.summary: A newly published study indicates that crisis resilience has fallen significantly in France, Greece, and the Netherlands. The assessment highlights emerging vulnerabilities in how those European states cope with major external shocks.

top_stories.title: Paris Motor Show Opens Amid European-Chinese Electric Vehicle Competition
top_stories.summary: The Paris Motor Show has commenced against the backdrop of escalating trade rivalry between the European Union and China. European manufacturers are navigating increased commercial pressure as Chinese automotive brands expand their presence across the continent.
